title: cozy winter date ideas (under $30)

slides.title: go ice skating
slides.detail: outdoor rinks are usually $10–20 each with rentals. hot chocolate after.

slides.title: a holiday lights walk
slides.detail: pick a street known for lights and bring a thermos of cocoa. free.

slides.title: fondue night at home
slides.detail: melted cheese, bread, apples, roasted potatoes. one pot, no reservation.

slides.title: a used bookstore date
slides.detail: pick a book for each other under $10, then read them over coffee.

slides.title: a big jigsaw puzzle
slides.detail: 1,000 pieces, snacks, a playlist. takes a few nights, which is the point.

slides.text: save this for the next cold weekend
